properties.label: Extended Property Configuration
properties.description:
Configure Microsoft Graph singleValueExtendedProperty used to load and display calendar events (for example, Matter ID).

Purpose:
• Used only to read and map extended metadata from Microsoft Calendar events.
• Helps associate events with business entities such as Matters, Cases, or References.

GUID & Name Guidelines:
• GUID must be a valid UUID in the format:
  xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx
• GUID must match the one used during event creation or update.
• Name must exactly match the extended property name stored in Microsoft Graph.
• GUID and Name together define a single extended property.

Important Notes:
• This configuration is read-only in this plugin.
• No filtering is performed using this extended property.
• Incorrect GUID or Name will simply result in empty or missing values, without errors.

properties.label: Event Color Configuration
properties.description:
Configure colors used to visually distinguish different types of Microsoft calendar events when displayed in Joget Calendar.

Color Usage:
• All Day Event Color – Applied to events marked as all-day.
• Teams Meeting Color – Applied to events with Microsoft Teams meetings enabled.
• Recurring Event Color – Applied to recurring events.
• Default Event Color – Used when no specific condition is matched.

Technical Notes:
• Colors must be valid HEX values (e.g. #22c55e).
• These colors are applied dynamically at runtime.
• Visual configuration does not affect event data or synchronization.

properties.label: Technical Configuration Notes
properties.description:
This plugin is designed to be used exclusively as a data source for Joget Calendar.

Calendar Configuration Requirements:
• Always select Auto Handle Date in Joget Calendar configuration.
• Set Data Source to this plugin.
• Choose 24-hour format for time display.
• Set date format to:
  yyyy-MM-dd

Behavior:
• Events are loaded directly from Microsoft Calendar using Graph API.
• No filtering is applied by this plugin.
• All date handling is managed by Joget Calendar itself.

Compatibility:
• Fully compatible with Joget Calendar.
• Supports all-day, timed, recurring, and Teams meeting events.
• Designed for display purposes only (read-only).
